title: Moments of Impermanence – Rising Light
statement:
This vertical iteration of Moments of Impermanence transforms dispersion into ascent. Millions of luminous particles gather, dissolve, and rise in continuous motion. No formation settles; direction, density, and color remain in flux — turquoise shifting into aquamarine, gold softening into violet — like breath moving upward through space.

In this format, movement feels lifted rather than expanded. The composition guides the eye vertically, reinforcing the idea that impermanence is not disappearance, but transition. Light does not fall — it rises.

Nothing stays. Everything evolves. That is the form.
